detailed_description:
[Shot 1]
At a nighttime car meet with overhead lights and parked cars, The woman (S1) walks in profile wearing her grey denim top and pants. After an off-camera male speaks, she stops and turns sharply to face the camera with a serious expression as the camera pushes in. The woman (S1) says: <d>[English]What did you say?</d> The off-camera voice responds, and she stares directly at the camera, her face softening into a smirk. She then laughs and says: <d>[English]I liked the first part better.</d> Finally, she turns away, raises her right hand to her hair, and walks off as the camera pans right.
